name: Final Sanction (Su)
category: Rogue Genius Games – Slayer Advanced Talents
body:
Prerequisite(s): Slayer 15th level, advanced talents, sanction
advanced talent

Benefit(s): Any magic used to restore to life a person the slayer killed must make a caster level check with a DC of 10 + slayer’s level (when the slayer killed the target). On a failed check, that magic from that source cannot restore the victim to life.

Advanced Options: Slayer Talents & Lethalities ©2014, Rogue Genius Games. Author: Owen K.C. Stephens.
